anlatim.ozet: Bu bölümde MEB'in yayımladığı gerçek örnek/çıkmış LGS İngilizce soruları yer alır. Gerçek sınav soruları olduğundan soru kökleri özgün hâliyle (İngilizce) verilmiştir. Her sorunun sağ üstünde yılı ve 'Çıkmış Soru' etiketi görünür; zor kategoride değerlendirilir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ekim Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: Nathalie: Hi Sophie, how are you? We are meeting at a café for Jane's birthday on Sunday evening. Can you come? — Sophie: Sure. I am really busy but I will be there. I don't know where the café is. Can you text me its address, please? According to the conversation, Sophie - - - -.

siklar.A: tells Nathalie what she is doing now
siklar.B: makes an excuse for not going there
siklar.C: cannot go there because she is busy
siklar.D: asks for some details about the event

sorular.cozum: Sophie kafenin adresini sorar ('Can you text me its address?'); yani etkinlikle ilgili ayrıntı ister. (asks for some details about the event)

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ekim Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Rosa's personal characteristics are: Honest, Responsible, Kind, Generous and Adventurous. Which of the following is NOT related to Rosa's personality?

siklar.A: She always says 'please' and tells the truth.
siklar.B: She buys presents for her friends.
siklar.D: She never changes her mind.

sorular.cozum: Honest/kind → 'says please, tells truth'; generous → 'buys presents'; adventurous → 'extreme sports'. 'Never changes her mind' (inatçılık) verilen özelliklerle ilgili değildir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ekim Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 4
sorular.soru: Poster: MOUNTAIN BIKE RIDING. Free sandwiches and fruit juice! Helmet is necessary. For more information, please contact Maggie at 0855 581 12 45. Date/time given on the poster. Which of the following DOES NOT have an answer in the poster?

siklar.A: How long is the trip?
siklar.B: Is there anything to eat?
siklar.D: Which equipment do we need?

sorular.cozum: Poster yiyeceği (sandwiches), iletişimi (Maggie) ve gerekli ekipmanı (helmet) verir; ancak gezinin ne kadar süreceği belirtilmemiştir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Kasım Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: Invitation: 'We are having a party for our son. Celebrate the 5th birthday of PAUL at The Apple Garden, 12 West Brooke Drive, San Diego. For more information, call Carol: 00123 987 654.' Which of the following DOES NOT have an answer in the invitation?

siklar.A: Who is the party for?
siklar.B: What time are they meeting?
siklar.C: Where is the party going to be?
siklar.D: How can they learn about the details of the event?

sorular.cozum: Davetiye kimin için olduğunu (Paul), yeri (The Apple Garden) ve nasıl bilgi alınacağını (Carol'u arayarak) verir; ancak saat belirtilmemiştir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Kasım Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: After a rock concert, people wrote notes to the singer. JANE: 'Your concert was magnificent. I was really happy.' SAM: 'It's the worst performance I've ever seen. Your behavior was insulting.' JOHN: 'Your music is impressive; I cannot stop listening to your songs.' MARY: 'Your concerts are always terrific; I am fond of your voice.' Whose comment was disappointing for the singer?

siklar.A: Sam
siklar.B: John
siklar.D: Mary

sorular.cozum: Jane, John ve Mary olumlu yorum yapar; yalnızca Sam ('worst performance', 'insulting') olumsuz, hayal kırıklığı yaratan bir yorum yazmıştır.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Aralık Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: The Kingston family is in the kitchen, talking about cooking chicken for dinner. One member says: 'I don't like fatty food; I think it is unhealthy.' Another says: 'We can't have a barbecue because it is rainy outside.' Another says: 'I don't like baked chicken; it is too dry.' Which of the following cooking methods is suitable for ALL the family members?

siklar.A: roasting
siklar.B: grilling
siklar.D: frying

sorular.cozum: Yağlı sevmeyen → frying elenir; yağmur → grilling/barbecue elenir; kuru sevmeyen → baking/roasting elenir. Geriye herkese uygun yöntem olarak boiling (haşlama) kalır.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Aralık Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Claire is a chef. Her restaurant is NOT suitable for people who like meat and pasta. Today she is cooking the speciality: 'Heat the oil; chop the onion, the carrot and some garlic; fry them; add sliced tomatoes and potatoes; pour water and boil; cook for 5 minutes; finally add a leaf of basil. Serve hot.' According to the recipe, in which restaurant does Claire work as a chef?

siklar.A: SPAGHETTI HOUSE
siklar.B: CITY OF FISH
siklar.D: VEGETABLE WORLD

sorular.cozum: Tarif tamamen sebzelerden (onion, carrot, tomato, potato) oluşur; et veya makarna yoktur. Bu yüzden Claire VEGETABLE WORLD'de çalışır.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ocak Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: Mary, Tom, Lisa and John ordered food at a restaurant. Mary never eats meat. Tom prefers eating only vegetables. Lisa enjoys eating sweets with fruit. John likes white meat and cold desserts. According to the information above, which of the following is NOT correct?

siklar.A: Mary ordered pasta as a main course.
siklar.B: Tom chose salad and meatballs.
siklar.C: Lisa ate a slice of strawberry cake.
siklar.D: John had both grilled chicken and ice cream.

sorular.cozum: Tom yalnızca sebze yer; köfte (meatballs) et olduğundan 'salad and meatballs' Tom için doğru olamaz. (Mary etsiz → pasta; Lisa meyveli tatlı → çilekli pasta; John beyaz et + soğuk tatlı → ızgara tavuk + dondurma.)

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ocak Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Jack reads the rules for a strong password: Use at least ten characters; use a mixture of letters, numbers and punctuation; do not use ordered letters/numbers (e.g. abcde, 12345); do not use personal information such as names, birth dates or phone numbers. Which of the following is an appropriate password for Jack?

siklar.A: 3.qa!iwf2m
siklar.B: 2007jack_7

sorular.cozum: A; on karakterli, harf-rakam-noktalama karışımıdır, sıralı dizi ve kişisel bilgi içermez. B isim/yıl, C sıralı dizi, D yalnız rakam (telefon) içerir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ocak Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 4
sorular.soru: Rules for using social media safely: confirm information before believing it; use private settings; be careful before posting; do not share your private life. Chris: 'When I see interesting news, I try to find out its source.' Sally: 'I am very careful before I post a photo or video online.' Tom: 'When I sign up, I make sure only my friends see what I post.' Emily: 'When I am online, I tell everybody my birthday, where I live and what I like.' Who does NOT follow the rules for using social media safely?

siklar.A: Tom
siklar.B: Sally
siklar.D: Emily

sorular.cozum: Emily kişisel bilgilerini (doğum günü, yaşadığı yer) herkesle paylaşır; bu, güvenli kullanım kuralına aykırıdır.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Ocak Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 5
sorular.soru: The data show what people did on the Net in a minute. Shared photos: 174.000 (2018) → 347.222 (2019). Searched for information: 3.7 million (2018) → 3.8 million (2019). Downloaded applications: 375.000 (2018) → 390.030 (2019). Watched videos: 4.3 million (2018) → 4.5 million (2019). According to the results, which of the following is NOT correct?

siklar.A: In 2018, people shared fewer photos than in 2019.
siklar.B: More people watched videos on the Net in 2018 than in 2019.
siklar.D: About four million people used search engines in both years.

sorular.cozum: Video izleme 2018'de 4.3 milyon, 2019'da 4.5 milyondur; yani 2019'da daha fazladır. 'B: 2018'de daha fazla' yanlıştır.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Şubat Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: Here is Mike's search history in the last two weeks: 'Facts about websites', 'Online courses', 'Social media addiction', 'Internet safety rules'. Which of the following is NOT related to Mike's search history?

siklar.A: The exact number of active Internet sites is unknown.
siklar.B: New generation smart phone war takes new shape.
siklar.C: 92% of teens go online daily and 24% say they are always online.
siklar.D: Many people practice a foreign language by using the Internet.

sorular.cozum: Mike'ın aramaları web siteleri, çevrim içi kurslar, sosyal medya bağımlılığı ve internet güvenliği ile ilgilidir; 'akıllı telefon savaşı' (B) bu konularla ilgili değildir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Şubat Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Emily, Sandra and Sally want to try extreme sports together. Emily enjoys being in the air; Sandra is interested in underwater sports; Sally is keen on speed. The weekly programme: Monday: Wind-surfing, Skydiving, Paragliding. Tuesday: Archery, Skateboarding, Hot-air balloon. Wednesday: Skydiving, Motor racing, Scuba diving. Thursday: Wind-surfing, Skateboarding, Rafting. Which of the following is a suitable day for all of them?

siklar.A: Monday
siklar.B: Tuesday
siklar.D: Thursday

sorular.cozum: Wednesday'de Skydiving (hava-Emily), Motor racing (hız-Sally) ve Scuba diving (su altı-Sandra) birlikte vardır; bu yüzden üçü için de uygundur.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Şubat Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 3
sorular.soru: RAFTING ON ÇORUH RIVER: Çoruh River is in the northeast of Turkey, one of the top ten white-water rivers in the world. Because of the water level, the best months for rafting are May and June. Travel companies provide wet suits, helmets, life jackets and other necessary things. While on a rafting holiday, you can camp by the river or stay in hotels or village houses. Which of the following is CORRECT according to the text?

siklar.A: People have to bring their own rafting equipment.
siklar.B: If you want to try rafting on Çoruh, go there in the winter.
siklar.C: Çoruh is the most popular white-water river in the world.
siklar.D: There are various accommodation options for rafting lovers.

sorular.cozum: Metne göre kamp yapılabilir ya da otel/köy evlerinde kalınabilir → çeşitli konaklama seçenekleri (D). Ekipman sağlanır (A yanlış), en iyi aylar Mayıs-Haziran (B yanlış), 'ilk on'dandır ama 'en popüler' denmez (C yanlış).

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Şubat Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 4
sorular.soru: Terry's notes about his friends' holidays: Lily likes water sports, so she will swim and scuba dive (13-20 June). Mary likes extreme sports, so she will do mountain biking and skydiving (18-22 May). Tom is going to a summer camp to learn about different cultures (21-23 August). Dave is interested in history, so he will visit Göbeklitepe, Şanlıurfa (22-24 April). Which of the following is NOT correct according to the information above?

siklar.A: Lily is planning a seaside holiday for the summer.
siklar.B: Mary and Dave prefer different kinds of holidays.
siklar.C: Lily's and Tom's holidays have the same duration.
siklar.D: Dave is going to visit an ancient site.

sorular.cozum: Lily'nin tatili (13-20 Haziran) yaklaşık bir hafta, Tom'unki (21-23 Ağustos) yaklaşık üç gün sürer; süreleri farklıdır, bu yüzden C doğru değildir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Şubat Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 5
sorular.soru: According to Terry's notes (Lily: water sports, 13-20 June; Mary: extreme sports, 18-22 May; Tom: summer camp to learn about cultures, 21-23 August; Dave: history, Göbeklitepe, 22-24 April), which of the following does NOT have an answer in the text?

siklar.A: Which equipment do they need on their holidays?
siklar.B: Who prefers going on an adventure holiday?
siklar.C: When are they going to have their holidays?
siklar.D: Why are they going on such holidays?

sorular.cozum: Notlar kimin ne tercih ettiğini (B, D) ve tarihleri (C) verir; ancak hangi ekipmana ihtiyaç duyacakları (A) belirtilmemiştir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mart Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: Philip: Hi, mom. I need your help. - - - -? Mom: Sure, honey. Philip: - - - -? Mom: You need a cup of red lentil, a carrot, a potato, an onion, a tablespoon of olive oil, four cups of water and a pinch of salt. Philip: They're ready. - - - -? Mom: First, peel and cut the carrot, potato and onion. Second, wash the lentil. Put all of them into a pot. Then add water and cook them. After that, mix it with a blender. Finally, add olive oil and salt. Philip: Thanks mom. Which of the following does NOT complete the conversation?

siklar.A: Can you give me a recipe for lentil soup
siklar.B: How long does it take to cook
siklar.D: What are the ingredients

sorular.cozum: Birinci boşluk tarif isteme (A), ikinci boşluk malzemeleri sorma (D), üçüncü boşluk hazırlama adımlarını sorma (C) ile tamamlanır. 'How long does it take to cook' (B) konuşmayı tamamlamaz; çünkü pişirme süresine dair bir cevap verilmemiştir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mart Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Tommy: Hey, there is an online course about Internet habits. - - - - Lilly: That would be great because I often go online. - - - - Tommy: I am sending you the link. Create an account, then register and log in. It will start at 9 p.m. tomorrow evening. Lilly: - - - - However, I will try to join it. Which of the following does NOT complete the conversation above?

siklar.A: Would you like to register?
siklar.B: My Internet is not working properly.
siklar.C: What is the web address of the course?
siklar.D: I am bad at face-to-face communication.

sorular.cozum: Birinci boşluk kayıt daveti (A), ikinci boşluk kursun adresini sorma (C), üçüncü boşluk katılmayı zorlaştıran bir engel belirtme (B) ile tamamlanır. Kurs çevrim içi olduğundan 'yüz yüze iletişimde kötüyüm' (D) konuşmayı tamamlamaz.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mart Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 3
sorular.soru: Nick: When I go on a holiday, I try different sports. I tried skydiving last summer. It requires a lot of courage and it is really exciting. You jump from a plane with a parachute. I have also done rafting and it was awesome. You travel down the river and try to stay on the boat. It is challenging and dangerous but I would like to do it again. If you ask me which sport I liked more, I would say skydiving. The text above is mainly about Nick's - - - -.

siklar.A: plans about future holidays
siklar.B: experiences with extreme sports
siklar.D: thoughts about transportation options

sorular.cozum: Nick, denediği skydiving ve rafting gibi ekstrem sporlardaki deneyimlerini anlatır; metnin ana konusu bu deneyimlerdir (B).

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mart Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 4
sorular.soru: Dean is organizing a chess tournament on Sunday. He sent messages to his friends to invite them. Tina: I will definitely be there. You have no chance to win. Sam: That sounds great, but I will be out of the town at the weekend. Clark: That's a good idea. Text me about the time. Peter: I'd love to join, but I have football training. I can join you after it. According to the conversation above, which of the following is CORRECT?

siklar.A: Tina isn't interested in playing chess.
siklar.B: Sam has to attend a course, so he can't join the tournament.
siklar.C: Clark needs extra information about the event.
siklar.D: Peter is available all day on Sunday.

sorular.cozum: Clark 'Text me about the time' diyerek etkinlikle ilgili ek bilgi (saat) ister; doğru ifade C'dir. Tina katılacaktır (A yanlış), Sam şehir dışında olacaktır (B yanlış, kurs değil), Peter ancak antrenmandan sonra katılabilir, tüm gün müsait değildir (D yanlış).

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mart Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 5
sorular.soru: Brian and Jenny want to do something different this weekend. Brian is interested in technology, books and paintings. Jenny is interested in sculpture, sports and fashion. According to their interests, which of the following is an appropriate place for them to go?

siklar.A: Art exhibition
siklar.B: Book fair
siklar.D: Cinema

sorular.cozum: Brian resimlerle (paintings), Jenny ise heykelle (sculpture) ilgilenir; ikisi de sanatla ilgilendiği için onlara uygun ortak yer bir sanat sergisidir (A).

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Nisan Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Alice, David, Mary and Tom are planning different free time activities for this week. The activity–day plan is: Monday – Doing sports; Thursday – Meeting friends; Saturday – Cycling; Sunday – Watching a movie. Alice is going to go to the cinema with her friends. Tom is going to go to the café with his buddies. David is going to ride a bike in the morning. Mary is going to play bowling after school. According to the information above, who is NOT planning an activity for the weekend?

siklar.A: Mary and Alice
siklar.B: Mary and Tom
siklar.D: David and Alice

sorular.cozum: Tabloya göre sinema (film izleme) Pazar, kafe (arkadaşlarla buluşma) Perşembe, bisiklet Cumartesi, bowling (spor) Pazartesidir. Alice (Pazar) ve David (Cumartesi) hafta sonu; Tom (Perşembe) ve Mary (Pazartesi) ise hafta içi etkinlik planlar. Hafta sonu planı olmayanlar Mary ve Tom'dur (B).

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Nisan Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 3
sorular.soru: Sam invites his friend Tom to dinner and wants to prepare meals according to Tom's preferences: Tom prefers meat to fish; he dislikes green vegetables; he isn't keen on cold desserts. According to the information above, which of the following is the most appropriate menu for Tom?

siklar.A: Potato Soup, Meatball, Ice Cream
siklar.B: Parsley Soup, Grilled Chicken, Cake
siklar.D: Tomato Soup, Steak, Hot Cocoa Rolls

sorular.cozum: A'da dondurma soğuk tatlı, B'de maydanoz çorbası yeşil sebze, C'de balık (Tom eti yeğler) ve soğuk puding vardır. D menüsü (domates çorbası, biftek, sıcak kakaolu rulo) Tom'un tüm tercihlerine uyar.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Nisan Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 5
sorular.soru: Online games are very popular among young people. Lots of children are becoming addicted to the Internet and online games. They play online games on their tablets or smartphones. These children spend 6-10 hours online and they rarely have face-to-face communication with their families. Some of them refuse to go to school because they want to stay at home and play games. Parents are not happy about their children. Which of the following does NOT have an answer in the text above?

siklar.A: What kind of devices can children use to play online games?
siklar.B: How much time do the addicted children spend online?
siklar.C: What are the reasons for online game addiction?
siklar.D: How do parents feel about their children's habits?

sorular.cozum: Metin cihazları (tablet/akıllı telefon → A), çevrim içi geçirilen süreyi (6-10 saat → B) ve ailelerin memnuniyetsizliğini (D) belirtir; ancak bağımlılığın nedenleri (C) metinde yer almaz.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mayıs Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 1
sorular.soru: Read the conversation and answer the question. Daisy: What do you like doing in your free time? Janet: I don't miss any plays. I am also fond of jazz and pop, but I dislike playing an instrument and playing team sports. Sam: I enjoy buying new things. I also like doing sports. However, painting and seeing a play are unbearable for me. According to the conversation above, which of the following are the most appropriate activities for Janet and Sam?

siklar.A: Janet: playing volleyball, joining a guitar course / Sam: going to the shopping mall, doing basketball training
siklar.B: Janet: watching a play, going to a concert / Sam: going to the theatre, joining a drawing course
siklar.C: Janet: swimming, playing the piano / Sam: watching a play, visiting an art exhibition
siklar.D: Janet: listening to music, going to the theatre / Sam: cycling, going shopping

sorular.cozum: Janet oyun/müzik sever ama enstrüman ve takım sporu sevmez; ona 'listening to music' ve 'going to the theatre' uygundur. Sam alışveriş ve spor sever ama resim ve tiyatro sevmez; ona 'cycling' ve 'going shopping' uygundur. Tüm tercihlere yalnızca D uyar.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mayıs Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 2
sorular.soru: Simon is planning to go to a book fair on Saturday afternoon with his friends and sends them an invitation. His friends' plans for Saturday are: Betty - going to a concert with Jane (4 pm-7 pm); Carl - visiting grandparents (10 am-1 pm); Tom - doing sports (9 am-12 pm); Lily - seeing a new play (3 pm-7 pm). According to the information above, which of the following is NOT an appropriate reply to Simon's invitation?

siklar.A: Hi, buddy. That's a good idea. I can join you after my football training.
siklar.B: Simon, the activity sounds a bit boring, but I will be there after our family breakfast.
siklar.C: Hello, Simon. That's really awesome but I will go to the cinema with my sister.
siklar.D: Hey, that's cool but in the afternoon I will go and listen to my favourite band.

sorular.cozum: Etkinlik Cumartesi öğleden sonradır. A ve B sabahki işi (spor/aile vakti) biten birinin sonra katılabileceğini, D öğleden sonra konser olduğu için gelemeyeceğini uygun biçimde belirtir. C'deki yanıt arkadaşların Cumartesi planlarıyla bağdaşmaz (planlarda sinema yoktur); bu nedenle uygun bir yanıt değildir.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mayıs Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 3
sorular.soru: Read the text and answer the question. My parents are going to have some guests for a party at home tonight. We are all very excited and we are helping each other. My mother is baking the chicken and my father is preparing the salad. I am making the desserts and my sister is setting the table. Which of the following has an answer in the text?

siklar.A: Why are they having a party?
siklar.B: When is the party going to be?
siklar.D: Which desserts is Mike making?

sorular.cozum: Metin partinin 'tonight' (bu gece) olacağını belirtir, bu yüzden B'nin cevabı vardır. Partinin nedeni (A), içecekleri kimin hazırladığı (C) ve hangi tatlıların yapıldığı (D) metinde yer almaz.

sorular.kaynak: MEB 2019-2020 Mayıs Ayı Örnek Soruları — İngilizce, Soru 4
sorular.soru: Read the conversation and answer the question. Customer Service: Hello, how can I help you? Alice: Hi, I want to book a flight ticket from London to New York. Customer Service: Sure. One way or return? Alice: Return. Customer Service: Can you tell me the dates on which you want to travel? Alice: June 15th and June 26th. Customer Service: Can I have your name and phone number, please? Alice: Alice Black, 09502345678. Customer Service: Your flight is reserved. Have a good flight. Which of the following does NOT have an answer in the conversation above?

siklar.A: What is the phone conversation about?
siklar.B: What is the destination of the flight?
siklar.C: What are the dates of the flights?
siklar.D: What is Alice's reason for travelling?

sorular.cozum: Konuşma uçak bileti rezervasyonuyla ilgilidir (A); varış yeri New York (B) ve tarihler June 15th-26th (C) bellidir. Alice'in seyahat nedeni (D) konuşmada yer almaz.
